summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnished with its 2025 Hong Kong Annual Report and Environmental, Social and Governance Report. The filing reports a change in non-executive directors effective April 21, 2026, and provides standard financial summaries, business review, and governance information. No acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or abrupt management changes are described. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to an annual report filing. What to watch: monitoring operational developments and director changes as part of normal due diligence.
